title: Say it with rhythm
description: A warm highlight follows a two-line phrase along a continuous, deliberately paced timeline.
useCase: Preview timed caption emphasis, lyric pacing or spoken-text motion before connecting media.
interaction: Play or pause the phrase, or scrub to an exact time.
reducedMotion: No automatic playback; the play control advances one word per activation. Scrubbing still selects exact times without moving the highlight.
limitations: A local 3.8-second timing study with authored word boundaries; no audio, transcription or alignment service.
look: Slate-navy page with a bold two-line sans-serif phrase in muted grey, one word on an amber rounded highlight, above a round play button and scrubber.
motion: Playing runs a 3.8 s timeline; at each authored beat an amber block slides and resizes onto the next word (350 ms ease-out), whose text darkens; scrubbing snaps it instantly.
adapt: Timing lives in `WORDS`, `BEATS` and `DURATION`; a `requestAnimationFrame` loop advances `time`. On each word change, measured bounds place `sf-cb-highlight` with translate; its fill scales horizontally between fixed rounded ends. The visible progress and thumb use transforms, while the semantic range input handles seeking. Replace the arrays and caption's `aria-label` with real word timings; preserve pointer and keyboard synchronization.
